RetentionStoreUsage.name: RetentionStoreUsage
RetentionStoreUsage.description: Represents the total usage of the org's retention store measured at specific points in time.

AttributeDetail.description: (For future use) Additional metadata or contextual details about the usage measurement.

MetricType.description: Categorizes the type of usage being measured. Only DATA type is currently captured. DATA: Total storage capacity usage (in bytes). FILES: Files and attachments storage capacity usage (in bytes). RECORDS: Retained record count (in rows). Only DATA type is currently captured.

Name.description: The name of the retention storage usage record.

OwnerId.description: The ID of the account owner associated with the storage.

RetentionType.description: Identifies which retention system this usage record belongs to.

UnitOfMeasure.description: Specifies the unit of measurement for the Usage field value.

Usage.description: The numeric usage value in the unit of measure specified in UnitOfMeasure.

UsageDateTime.description: Timestamp when the usage measurement was captured.
